title: "Farq sirf uniform ka hai"
situation: Before the October protest, Delhi Police's social media runs a humanising campaign: open letter, trending music, injured women officers, an officer fixing a detained leader's clothes.

lines.text: Farq sirf uniform ka hai, insaaniyat ka nahi.
lines.speaker: Delhi Police open letter

lines.text: Different sides of line yet same womanhood
lines.speaker: Delhi Police post

buildThis.situation: The police have their own reel account in the phone feed; it posts a clip of Sharma helping someone you helped first, with no credit.
